d: Radical post-human and technological singularity futures across the Solar System by Hannu Rajaniemi and Charles Stross.

mars.x: Vast mobile Martian city creeping along tracks across the sands, whose citizens trade memory and lifespans through the cryptographic Time currency.
mars.a: oubliette flambeur gogol gevulot zoku jean

phobos.x: Virtual panopticon carved into Phobos where digital minds are subjected to endless iterated Prisoner’s Dilemmas by the Archons.

mercury.x: Inner planets dismantled into dense computational nodes and solar-sail smart matter enclosing the Sun as humanity transcends into the Singularity.

saturn.x: Vast android civilization flourishing in floating Saturnian habitats and airless moons long after the extinction of biological humanity.

b.s: High-concept transhuman settings across Sol, including Hannu Rajaniemi’s moving Martian city the Oubliette in The Quantum Thief, Charles Stross’s dismantled inner planets and Matrioshka Swarm in Accelerando, and autonomous post-biological android societies in Saturn’s Children.
b.r: The Quantum Thief (2010), Accelerando (2005), and Saturn’s Children (2008)
